1b1(mdo): @##//rgya gar skad du/puN+ya ba la a ba dA na/bod skad du/bsod

2a1(mdo): @##//la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag 'di na mi blun po la la dam pa'i chos ma

2b1(mdo): can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro//dge slong dag skyes bu dam pa chos gsum dang ldan pa ni sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed la tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te gnas so//
2b2(mdo): gsum gang zhe na/'di ltar ma chags pa dang /ser sna'i dri ma dang bral ba dang /bag yod pa rnams so//dge slong dag chos gsum po 'di dag dang ldan na skyes bu dam pa sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing 
2b3(mdo): bsod nams dag byas la/tshul khrims yang dag par bla nges te gnas pas lus zhig ste shi ba'i 'og tu bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro//bcom ldan

2b5(mdo): sbyin pa sbyin par mi byed de//de phyir bsod nams 'dod pa yi//shes pas sbyin pa sbyin par bya//ser sna can gyi 'jigs pa ni//bkres dang skom pa 'di yin na//gang gis 'jigs pas

2b7(mdo): de ni shi ma yin//rgyags bzang ba'i 'dron po bzhin//gang dag shin du gtang dka' ba//nyung ngu'am mang po gtong byed na//gtang dka' gtong ba de dag ni//dka' ba'i las dag 
2b8(mdo): byed pa yin//dam pa min pas mi rtogs te//dam pa'i chos las 'da' mi byed//de phyir dam pa dam pa byin//'di nas shi bar gyur pa na//dam pa ma yin dmyal bar 'gro//dam pa 
3a1(mdo): @#//dag ni mtho ris 'gro//rga bas gtses pa la ni skyabs med de//tshe thung bas ni grog khyer dus kyang nye//'chi bas 'jigs pa 'di mthong rnams kyis ni//bsod nams 
3a2(mdo): bde sbyor bdag ni bya ba'i rigs//bud med spangs 'dir bor bas 'tsho ba gang //dga' bas sbyin pa nyung ngu byin na yang //stong gi mchod sbyin brgya stong byed pa ni//de yi bcu drug char yang 
3a3(mdo): mi phod do//ci phyir mchod sbyin yangs shing rgya che ba//mchod sbyin 'thun pa de yi lam mi 'gro//ji ltar stong gi mchod sbyin stong rnams kyang //de yi bcu drug char mi 'gyur zhe na//byis

3a8(mdo): nang du zhugs te//nyin par gnas pa'i phyir shing zhig gi drung na gnas shing bzhugs so//de'i tshe dge slong mang po dag 'dun khang du 'dus shing 'khod pa'i skabs su tshul 'di lta 
3b1(mdo): bur tshe dang ldan pa dag mi rnams kyi nyams su dben pa gang yin zhes gtam du glengs so//de'i tshe 'chos ldan 'das kyi gcung gru'i bu tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo dang /tshe dang ldan pa gro zhin skyes bye ba nyi 
3b2(mdo): shu pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa dang /tshe dang ldan ba shA ri'i bu rnams kyang 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'bod do//de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' pos smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag 
3b3(mdo): byad gzugs ni mi rnams kyi nyams su dpen pa yin no//tshe dang ldan pa gro zhin skye bye ba nyi shu bas smras pa/tshe dang ldan ba dag brtson 'grus ni mi rnams kyi nyams sud ben pa yin no//
3b4(mdo): tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags bas smras pa/tshe dang lda na pa dag bzod pa ni mi rnams kyi nyams sus ben pa yin no//tshe dang lan pa shA ri'i bus smras pa/tshe dang ldan dag shes rab 'ba' 
3b5(mdo): shig mi rnams kyi nyams su dben pa yin no//zhes glengs nas de dag 'di skad du/tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag kun mi mthun par gyur te/'di ltar tha dad par brtags kyis/bdag 
3b6(mdo): cag bcom ldan 'das kyi tha dad du song ste don 'di nyid zhus la/bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ci skad du lung ston pa de bzhin du gzung bar bya'o zhes zer nas tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 
3b7(mdo): 'das ni/ston pa thugs rje chen po ste//thams cad mkhyen pa the tsom bsal//de ni som nyid gcod pa ste//nyi mas mun pa bsal ba bzhin//sdug bsngal dra bas klags pa dang //
3b8(mdo): log pa'i lam la gnas pa yi//srog chags rnams kyi skyabs gcig ste//bu rnams kyi ni nga mchog bzhin//de phyir chos kun dbang phyug po//sems can kun gyi don brtson pa//
4a1(mdo): @#//thub pa the tsom gcod de la//bdag cag kun kyis zhu bar bya//som nyi mdud pa chen po ni//gang phyir rgyal ba gcod par 'gyur//de phyir thams cad dong nas ni//
4a2(mdo): de bzhin gshegs la zhu bar bya//zhes byas nas dge slong mang po de dag bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir 'gro bar chas pa las/bcom ldan 'das nyin par gnas pa'i phyir nags stug 
4a3(mdo): po'i nang na bzhugs pa'i bar skabs su dge slong mang po dag 'dun khang du 'dus shing 'khod de/skabs su tshul de lta bu'i gtam glengs pa/lha'i snyan rnam par dag pa mi las 'das pas 
4a4(mdo): gsan to//gsan nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te 'dun khang ga la 'dug par gshegs so//gshegs nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa de nyid 
4a5(mdo): la bzhugs so//bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa dang /dge slong dag dge slong mang po 'dun khang du 'dus shing /'khod pa rnams kyis skabs 
4a6(mdo): kyi gtam ci zhig glengs da ltar khyed gtam ji lta bu zhig gi phyir 'dus shing 'khod/gsol pa/btsan pa bdag cag dge slong mang po 'dun/khang 'dir 'dus shing mchis pa rnams 
4a7(mdo): kyis skabs su tshul 'di lta bur tshe dang ldan pa dag mi rnams kyi nyams su dben pa gang lags shes bka' mchid bgyis so//de la tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo'i mchid nas ni tshe dang ldan 
4a8(mdo): pa dag byad gzugs mi rnams kyi nyams su dpen pa lags so zhes mchi/tshe dang ldan pa gro zhin skyes bye ba nyi shu ba'i mchid nas ni tshe dang ldang ba dag brtson 'grus mi rnams kyi nyams su 
4b1(mdo): dben pa lags so zhes mchi/tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'i mchid nas ni tshe dang ldan pa dag bzo mi rnams kyi nyams su dben pa lags so zhes ma chi/tshe dang ldan pa shA ri'i bu'i mchid nas ni 
4b2(mdo): tshe dang ldan pa dag shes rab 'ba' shig mi rnams kyi nyams su dbain pa lags so zhes mchi ste/btsun pa bdag cag rnams 'di snyam bgyid do//tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag kun mi mthun 
4b3(mdo): par 'gyur te/'di ltar tha dad par brtags kyis bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du mchis te don 'di nyid zhus la/bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la ji skad du lung ston pa de bzhin 
4b4(mdo): gzung bar bgyi'o snyam bgyid do//btsun pa bdag cag dge slong mang po 'dun khang du 'dus shing mchis pa rnams kyis skabs kyi bka' mchid 'di glengs te/da ltar bdag cag bka' mchid 
4b5(mdo): 'di'i slad du 'dus shing mchis lags so//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa//sems can rnams kyi gzugs dang bzo//brtson 'grus dang ni 
4b6(mdo): shes rab gzhan//bsod nams dag las 'byung bas na//de phyir bsod nams dam pa yin//zhes gsungs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ci yang rung 
4b7(mdo): ste/lan 'ga' tsam du zad kyi dus thams cad du kun nyams su dben pa ma yin no//bsod nams ni dus thams cad du srog chags thams cad kyi nyams su dben pa yin te/dge slong

5a1(mdo): @#//pa'i dus na/rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor zhig na/rgyal po gsal stobs zhes bya ba zhig rgyal po byed de de'i ring la 'byor pa dang /rgyas pa dang /bde ba dang /lo legs
